# CHAESSI PRESET v3.8.4

v3.8.4 makes it easier to paint precise masks in the workbench and arrange images on an expanded canvas.

## Workbench Inpaint

Use the wheel or +/− to zoom the Inpaint view. Wheel zoom follows the cursor. Toggle Pan view or drag with the middle button. Use Fit view or 100% to reset the view. Brush and eraser strokes stay aligned to source pixels at every zoom level, with Undo/Redo available.

## Outpaint with a custom canvas

Choose **Outpaint with custom canvas** in workbench Inpaint or Image tools → Outpainting. Select 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9, or enter Width and Height and apply the output size. Drag the source to position it and use a corner handle to resize it. Check the empty area to be filled, then review the image and mask before generating.

Entered dimensions round to the nearest multiple of 8 pixels. Each side must be 64–4096 pixels, with a maximum of 3,145,728 pixels in total. The generation canvas may differ from the publishing platform’s file requirements.

## Compatibility and updating

The app carries forward v3.8.3 features and data formats. Existing presets, History, images and settings remain usable. Save your work, close the app and back up the entire data folder before replacing the EXE.

## Verification

The PRIVATE implementation passed 23 automated checks and 19 Electron UI checks. The integrated public source passed 15 automated checks and 19 Electron UI checks. Portable results are recorded in the published Release. Verification used temporary profiles and mocked responses. It involved zero paid NovelAI generations or generated-image quality checks.

## 2026-11-11 revision — Preset list browsing

The Base and Character preset pickers start with 50 items. **Load more** adds 50 at a time, and **Show all** displays every matching preset. Both pickers share the display limit and remember it after applying a preset, reopening the picker, or changing search, categories, or sorting. Restarting the app resets the limit to 50.

History still loads 50 at a time. Saved presets and settings keep their existing formats.

## 2026-11-14 revision — Independent browsing for each prompt field

Base and each numbered Character prompt field now remember their own preset display limit, Show all mode, scroll position, and sorting. Applying a preset or reopening the picker restores that field's last position. **Load more** adds 50 presets at a time, and **Show all** displays every matching item. Changing search, categories, or sorting scrolls only the current field's list to the top. Restarting the app resets each field to 50 items and the top of the list.

Existing presets, settings, and per-field search and category memory are retained. History continues to load 50 items at a time.
